names.th: จิกุซากุมะ

description.fun: Zigzagoon can't walk in a straight line: it wanders restlessly back and forth, nose to the ground, leaving zigzag footprints, and it's good at picking up lost items. It plays dead to fool opponents. Ken Sugimori says its name came before its design, and its family tells a little story of movement: Zigzagoon zigzags, Linoone runs straight, and Obstagoon blocks the way.
description.guide: A Normal-type, raccoon-like Pokémon with zigzag-patterned fur that wanders in zigzags and picks up items. It evolves into Linoone at level 20. Its Dark- and Normal-type Galarian form, thought to be the original, evolves through Galarian Linoone into Obstagoon.
description.tagline: A restless raccoon that can't help walking in zigzags

names.ja: ガラル ジグザグマ

description.fun: Galarian Zigzagoon is black and white with its tongue always hanging out, and it's believed to be the original form of the species. It loves a fight and tries to provoke everyone it meets, though people usually mistake that for a bid for affection, much to its frustration.

Linoone can sprint at 60 miles an hour, but only in a straight line: it has to stop to turn, so it often misses its prey and struggles on winding roads. It's drawn to anything round, stuffing such finds into its cheek pouches and hiding them in secret stashes around its territory. Its shed fur makes high-quality shaving brushes.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon, the evolution of Zigzagoon, with a slender, striped body. It runs very fast but only in straight lines. Its Galarian form is Dark and Normal and evolves into Obstagoon.
description.tagline: A speedster that can only run in a perfectly straight line

names.ja: ガラル マッスグマ

description.fun: Galarian Linoone taunts foes with its long tongue, then charges at up to 60 miles an hour with tackles strong enough to knock a car away, which makes it popular with Galar's frustrated, angry youths. Galar's harsh conditions sharpened its survival instincts until it could evolve into Obstagoon.

names.th: กาลาร์ ทาจิฟซากุมะ

description.fun: Obstagoon would rather taunt you into attacking first: it crosses its arms in its signature Obstruct pose and lets out a yell loud enough to rattle the attacker's defences, then strikes back with sharp claws. With its stark black-and-white look and lolling tongue it's styled on glam rock, and one even plays in a band called the Maximizers in Sword and Shield.
description.guide: A Dark- and Normal-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 8, the evolution of Galarian Linoone. It is a bipedal, badger-like fighter that blocks attacks with its signature move, Obstruct. Its design draws on the European badger and glam rock.
description.tagline: A glam-rock badger that crosses its arms and dares you to hit

note.text: Only Galarian Linoone evolves into Obstagoon, at night from level 35; Linoone from anywhere else doesn't evolve any further.
